definitions: A predefined sequence of steps or individuals to whom an issue or request is progressively referred when it cannot be resolved at a lower level.
The route or process by which a problem or concern is moved to higher levels of authority or management for resolution.
examples: The customer service team follows a clear escalation path for unresolved complaints.
Understanding the escalation path is crucial for project managers.
The IT department has a well-documented escalation path for system outages.
